finding: Authentication callbacks logged full URLs and provider/parser errors that could include credentials or personal information.
change: Every diagnostic in AuthCallbackScreen now emits one fixed event/outcome label. URLs, token/code/hash/type values and error objects are excluded from all console arguments. Authentication operations and flow are unchanged.

verification.method: Execute the actual screen module with synthetic Linking/Auth/React adapters; capture every console method and assert that credentials still reach the intended provider operations without appearing in diagnostic output.

verification.note: Integrated repository findings; existing native warnings are recorded separately.

coveredCases: Cold PKCE callback including email query parameter
Stored access/refresh credentials with returned provider errors
Warm token-hash callback with an untrusted type parameter
Thrown parser, provider and initial-link errors
